newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds steady, focus on U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds steady, focus on U.S. data.

text.p: 1025 GMT - Portuguese bonds were steady in tight liquidity as market makers dominated trade. Investors awaited U.S. jobs, NAPM data. Spreads against Bunds widened slightly.
*Spread vs 10-yr cash Bund 72 bps vs 70 bps
Portuguese bonds were steady as market makers dominated activity ahead of the release of U.S. jobs and NAPM data.

"Ten-year Portuguese bonds are losing slightly against Bonos and Bunds, but above all the market is characterised by a lack of liquidity as it awaits the opening of Treasuries and the release of unemployment and NAPM data," one operator said.
Another said: "The market was firm at the opening, then fell, and now it is stuck."
